# GPX 1.1 schema

`gpx.xsd` is the official GPX 1.1 schema, downloaded on 2026-11-18 from
https://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1/gpx.xsd (26,665 bytes, sha256
`9e4d1988b862edbe556305b130f8f6f1b29864fefd0dc02d5dab04ccdd1f34d6`). It imports nothing, so the
tests validate offline with lxml (Phase 4 amendment 9).
